title: Kickbacks launches ads inside Claude Code spinners to pay developers #Kickbacks #ClaudeCode #adtech
description:
Kickbacks launched a VS Code extension that places ads inside the Claude Code loading spinner, allowing developers to earn money during wait times. Advertisers bid for 5-second slots to display sponsored messages while Claude processes, and developers receive up to 70% of the ad revenue automatically.

This innovation transforms idle waiting moments into monetized opportunities but currently generates very modest income, with early testers making only cents per session. The founder suggests potential growth could offset subscription costs, yet the marketplace is still in its infancy, with minimal advertising demand.

Kickbacks offers a novel way to rethink passive app usage, highlighting emerging ad monetization models in software development environments. Its impact on developer revenue streams depends on scaling advertiser participation and user adoption.
